dataList.content:
Another veteran appeared from the dark, his gait grim and heavy.
黑暗中，又一名表情阴郁的残兵露出身影。
dataList.place:
District 4 - LC Branch Interior
4区 脑叶公司支部内某处

dataList.content:
He must've been a high-ranking soldier once—despite its age, his badge still gleamed.
他佩戴着一枚勋章。虽然看起来很老旧，却依然熠熠生辉，昭示着其主人也曾有过非凡的地位。

I think I know your face. But from where?
总感觉我也应该认得你的脸。为什么会觉得脸熟呢？

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.teller:
Decrepit G Corp. Head Manager
衰老的旧G公司部长
dataList.content:
... I was the head manager of your team.
……我曾是你的部长。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.teller:
Decrepit G Corp. Head Manager
衰老的旧G公司部长
dataList.content:
It's incredible how a deserter like you has the audacity to kill my men—they were once your own comrades, you know.
你嫌独自逃命还不够，现在还要对既是你的老战友，又是我的部下的那些家伙们痛下杀手。

Look, the war ended a decade ago. Haven't any of you learned to move on from playing soldiers?
你看，战争早在十年前就结束了。你还没从军队过家家中清醒过来吗？

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.teller:
Decrepit G Corp. Head Manager
衰老的旧G公司部长
dataList.content:
Ended? Nothing has ended.
结束？什么都没结束。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.teller:
Decrepit G Corp. Head Manager
衰老的旧G公司部长
dataList.content:
Nothing... has ended... dammit...
什么……都……没有结束……

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant

dataList.teller:
Decrepit G Corp. Head Manager
衰老的旧G公司部长
dataList.content:
The war might've ended for you when you deserted G Corp....
不过对于从G公司逃走的你来说，那战争可能确实是结束了。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.teller:
Decrepit G Corp. Head Manager
衰老的旧G公司部长
dataList.content:
... but for the rest of us—we never left the battlefield, even to this day.
而我们，仍旧坚守在战火纷飞的战场中央。

As much as I'd rather not relate to you this way...
虽然不想认同这种事……

I’m not really that different here.
但我也没有多大的区别。

dataList.title:

dataList.teller:

dataList.content:
Then you ought to understand, Manager Gregor.
既然如此，你也得理解一下了，科长。

dataList.title:

Only one verdict awaits deserters.
对于战场上的逃兵，所得出的结论向来都一样。

You say that like it means something... But it’s against company policy to carry out summary execution for personal revenge, bossman.
虽然你说得还挺像那么一回事……但为了报复进行即刻处刑是违反公司规定的，部长兄。
